title: Freshers' Tech Orientation
description: A welcome session for new computing students — chapter structure, mentorship pairing, and a first look at what NACOS Nile runs all year.

title: CodeSprint 48-Hour Hackathon
description: Teams of 3–5 build a working prototype from scratch in 48 hours, judged by faculty and industry mentors. Free food, prizes for top three teams.

title: Systems Architecture Masterclass
location: Virtual — link shared in the WhatsApp community
description: A hands-on walkthrough of designing systems that scale, led by a NACOS Nile alum now working in backend infrastructure.

title: Guild Dinner Night
description: The chapter's end-of-semester dinner — awards, executive handovers, and a chance to unwind with the whole community before exams.

title: CyberDef Defense Briefing
description: A guided walkthrough of common attack patterns and how to defend against them, run by the chapter's security interest group ahead of exam season.

title: New Semester Kickoff
description: Back from break — a look at the new semester's project tracks, mentorship batches, and what's on the calendar next.

title: Career & Mentorship Day
description: Alumni now working across the industry return to run résumé clinics, mock interviews, and 1:1 mentorship speed-rounds.

title: Founders' Day Demo Showcase
description: Teams demo what they've shipped over the semester to faculty, alumni, and industry guests, with awards for the standout builds.

title: Spring Hack Jam
description: A one-day build sprint — pick a track, form a team on the spot, and ship something demoable by evening.

title: Women in Tech Panel
description: Women engineers from the chapter and industry talk career paths, mentorship, and building in rooms where you're the only one like you.

title: Cloud & DevOps Bootcamp
location: Virtual — link shared in the WhatsApp community
description: Containers, CI/CD, and shipping to the cloud — a practical half-day bootcamp for students who've never deployed anything past localhost.

title: Alumni Homecoming Mixer
description: Alumni back on campus to reconnect, swap stories, and meet the current executive council over food and music.

title: Open Source Sprint
description: A guided first-contribution day — pick a real open-source issue, pair up, and land your first merged pull request.

title: AI & ML Study Jam
description: A student-led study group working through the fundamentals together, from linear regression up to a first neural net.

title: Executive Strategic Retreat
location: Off-campus — details shared with incoming excos
description: The incoming executive council plans the next academic year's calendar, budget, and priorities before handover.

title: Capstone Project Clinic
description: Drop-in office hours with senior students and faculty for final-year students stuck on their capstone projects.

title: CTF Qualifiers
location: Virtual — link shared in the WhatsApp community
description: An online capture-the-flag qualifier — top scorers represent NACOS Nile at the inter-chapter finals later in the year.

title: Welcome Back Social
description: A low-key evening to kick off the new academic year — new members, old faces, free food.
